audit.why: Emerald+ 51.03% over 535 games — by far the largest sample in this slice — supports EVEN at 5.5/10.
Skill windows through the early levels, Locke at 6 and first item on Purgatory's execute, back to even late. That matches an execute ult on a 120s rank-1 cooldown against a poke mage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup is nowhere on the page: Purgatory GROUNDS. Inside it, Across the Veil and Between Worlds are both switched off — Aurora's whole escape kit stops existing, which is why the execute connects.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/locke.json carries the grounding property on R; Aurora's W and R are both dashes and are exactly what grounding denies. champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags this pair explicitly.
audit.corrected: Leave the zone before you need the leap — once Purgatory is down you are grounded, and no amount of HP buffer replaces an escape you cannot cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block says Ashen Pursuit 'resets on takedowns'. Riot's data gives it a flat 10s cooldown and an AUTO-ATTACK reset — nothing about takedown resets.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target.' The reset property is on his attack, not his cooldown.
audit.corrected: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s and resets his auto — the wind-up on that attack is the tell, and the cooldown does not refund on a kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Silver Stake scales with your MISSING health, which is what makes Purgatory's execute floor so much higher than it looks. That link is never made.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.'
audit.corrected: Every point of HP you lose makes his autos hit harder, so the last 30% of your bar drains faster than the first — his execute threshold is effectively higher than the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Ignition heals back a portion of the self-damage he takes, and no anti-heal timing is given anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.'
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds applied before Soul Ignition ends cuts the refund — chip him during the effect, not after it.
